description: Change a post that is still QUEUED — move it to a different time, rewrite the caption, swap the media, add or drop a channel, or change which board / Page / company Page / listing it goes to. PASS ONLY WHAT CHANGES: an omitted field is left exactly as it was, and an explicit empty string CLEARS one (linkedinOrganizationId:"" moves a company-Page post back to the person’s own profile). The edited item is re-checked against the identical rules its create passed — visibility the channel can honour, per-channel length, media the channel can carry — so an edit can never slip past a refusal that a create would have caught. Get the id from list_scheduled. Something that already went out cannot be changed: a published post is edited or removed with manage_meta_post / manage_linkedin_post / delete_x_post, not rescheduled.

actionType.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — the call-to-action button; "" clears it.

aiGenerated.description: INSTAGRAM / FACEBOOK REEL — Meta’s is_ai_generated self-disclosure. OMIT IT and Hermoso decides from provenance: a Hermoso render is declared, media that came through upload_file or from an external URL (the user’s own photographs or footage) is NOT — a real photo must never carry Instagram’s “AI info” label. Pass true or false only to override: false strips the label from something Hermoso would otherwise declare, true declares a render the user uploaded themselves.

altText.description: ACCESSIBILITY — replace the screen-reader description(s). A STRING describes every slide; an ARRAY describes them one at a time in slide order and REPLACES the whole list. "" clears it.

at.description: the new time — ISO timestamp (2026-08-05T09:00:00Z) or epoch milliseconds. Must be in the future, at most 365 days out.

audience.description: FACEBOOK — replaces who can see the Page post {countries, regions, cities, minAge}; {} removes the limit.

audioId.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — put one of Instagram’s OWN licensed music tracks under the Reel: the `id` search_instagram_audio returns. Instagram mixes it in when the Reel is published; nothing is downloaded or re-rendered. REELS ONLY; an empty string removes it, and only on an Instagram account connected through Meta (a Facebook Page with a linked Instagram), which is Instagram’s own rule — the Instagram connector cannot take it and is refused by name.

audioName.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — replaces the audio track name; an empty string removes it.

audioVolume.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — how loud that track plays, 0–100 (Instagram’s default 100). Needs audioId.

boardId.description: PINTEREST — move the Pin to a different board (list_pinterest_boards)

brand.description: WHICH BRAND this post is in — id or exact name from list_brands; needed when it is not the brand this connection is pinned to. A name that matches no brand, or two, is REFUSED.

brandedContent.description: TIKTOK — the paid-partnership disclosure; false turns it off.

brandedContentSponsorIds.description: INSTAGRAM — replaces the sponsor user ids behind the paid-partnership label (at most 2); [] removes them.

callToAction.description: FACEBOOK — replaces the button on the Page post; "" removes it.

callToActionLink.description: FACEBOOK — replaces where the button goes; an empty string falls back to the post link.

captions.description: replaces the WHOLE per-channel caption map — send every override you want to keep, not just the new one

chatId.description: TELEGRAM — send it to a different chat, group or channel (@username or numeric id). It can be changed but never cleared: telegram cannot publish without one.

collaborators.description: INSTAGRAM — replaces the WHOLE collab list (up to 3 usernames); an explicit [] removes the co-authors and the post goes out as an ordinary single-author post. Only takes effect if the post has not fired yet — an invite already sent cannot be withdrawn from here.

commercialContent.description: TIKTOK — the COMMERCIAL CONTENT DISCLOSURE toggle: true when this post promotes a brand, product or service at all. TikTok requires at least one of yourBrand / brandedContent once it is on, and refuses a post that declares itself commercial without naming which kind. Either disclosure already implies it.

communityId.description: X — the community to publish into; an empty string goes back to the main timeline.

countryCodes.description: THREADS ONLY — two-letter country codes limiting who can see the post.

coverAtMs.description: THE VIDEO COVER on every channel, as one frame in milliseconds (see schedule_post).

coverImageUrl.description: THE VIDEO COVER on every channel, as a Hermoso-hosted picture (see schedule_post).

coverTimestampMs.description: TIKTOK VIDEO ONLY — cover frame in milliseconds.

coverUrl.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — replaces the cover image url; an empty string removes it.

crossreshareDarkMode.description: THREADS ONLY — dark-mode that Instagram Story. Needs crossreshareToIg.

crossreshareToIg.description: THREADS ONLY — also share to Instagram as a Story when it fires; false turns it off. Refused on a carousel.

description.description: YOUTUBE — replace the video description; "" clears it and the caption is used.

disableComment.description: TIKTOK — comments off on this post.

event.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — replaces the whole event record {title, startDate, startTime, endDate, endTime}.

id.description: the scheduled post id from list_scheduled

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

imageUrls.description: replace the CAROUSEL slides, in order; an empty array [] drops the carousel and goes back to a single image. Omit to leave the slides exactly as they are. The edited item is re-checked against the same carousel rules the create passed, so adding a channel that cannot swipe is refused now rather than posting slide 1 later.

instagramLocationId.description: INSTAGRAM — replaces the tagged place (the numeric id of its Facebook Page); an empty string removes it. Not locationId, which is the Google Business listing.

linkAttachment.description: THREADS ONLY — a full http(s) URL rendered as a link card on a TEXT-ONLY post. The only way a Threads post carries a destination.

linkDescription.description: FACEBOOK — replaces the link preview description; an empty string removes the override.

linkName.description: FACEBOOK — replaces the link preview headline; an empty string removes the override.

linkPicture.description: FACEBOOK — replaces the link preview image url; an empty string removes the override.

linkedinOrganizationId.description: LINKEDIN — target a different company Page, or "" to post as the connected person instead

madeWithAi.description: X — the AI-media label; false turns it off.

message.description: replace the caption used for every channel that has no override

offer.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — replaces the whole offer record {couponCode, redeemOnlineUrl, termsConditions}.

optimizeCopy.description: fit the shared caption to each channel’s own rules when you schedule it (the fitted caption is stored on the scheduled post, so what you scheduled is what publishes) wherever no per-channel caption was written; a channel with its own caption is left exactly as written. Send false to switch it off on this item.

pageId.description: FACEBOOK / INSTAGRAM / THREADS — publish from a different connected Page (list_meta_pages)

paidPartnership.description: INSTAGRAM AND X — the paid-partnership label; false turns it off.

place.description: FACEBOOK — replaces the tagged place (the numeric id of its Facebook Page); an empty string removes it.

platformCover.description: VIDEO COVER. Omit it (the default) and Hermoso sets the video’s best frame — the same frame as its Library thumbnail — as the cover on every channel that allows one — and on X, Threads and Bluesky, which have none, a blank first frame is replaced on a copy sent there only. true = send no cover and let the platform pick (usually the first frame). A cover you pass yourself always wins.

poll.description: X — replaces the poll; an empty options list removes it.

privacyLevel.description: TIKTOK — WHICH PRIVACY LEVEL the post goes out at, in TikTok’s own vocabulary. TikTok requires the USER to choose this from the levels their own account allows: call tiktok_creator_info, show them the real options, and pass back the one they picked — never a default and never a guess, which TikTok refuses at init. Omit it and the post falls back to the coarse `visibility` (private -> SELF_ONLY, otherwise PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE), which cannot express MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS or FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR at all. It must agree with the TikTok visibility (SELF_ONLY is the private one) and it is refused on a TikTok DRAFT, which carries no post info.

quotePostId.description: THREADS ONLY — the id of the Threads post this one quotes.

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

replySettings.description: X — who may reply; "" goes back to everyone.

shareToFeed.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — whether the Reel also shows in the Feed grid.

slideText.description: PINTEREST CAROUSEL ONLY — per-slide title / description / link, aligned to slide order.

story.description: INSTAGRAM — true makes it a 24-hour Story, false an ordinary feed post. One image or one video, no carousel.

tags.description: YOUTUBE — replaces the WHOLE tag list; an empty array [] clears the tags.

targetAudience.description: LINKEDIN COMPANY PAGE — replaces who sees the post; {} removes the limit. The matching audience must be over 300 followers.

thread.description: X — replaces the WHOLE thread; an explicit [] drops back to a single post using the caption.

thumbOffset.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — replaces the cover frame, in milliseconds; 0 removes it. Never together with coverUrl.

thumbnailUrl.description: YOUTUBE: replace the custom thumbnail; "" goes back to a frame of the video, "auto" to YouTube’s pick.

title.description: PINTEREST / YOUTUBE — replace the headline; "" clears it and goes back to deriving one from the caption

topicTag.description: THREADS ONLY — one topic tag, without the leading #.

topicType.description: GOOGLE BUSINESS — the kind of Post; EVENT and OFFER both require `event`.

trialReel.description: INSTAGRAM — replaces the trial-reel setting on a queued Reel (MANUAL or SS_PERFORMANCE); an explicit "" turns the trial off and it goes out as an ordinary Reel. Only takes effect while the post is still queued — a Reel already published cannot be converted into a trial.

videoVolume.description: INSTAGRAM REEL — how loud the video’s own sound plays under the track, 0–100 (Instagram’s default 100; 0 = the track alone). Needs audioId.

visibility.description: NOTE: changing this without also naming visibilityByChannel clears any per-channel overrides, so "make it all draft" is not a no-op

xArticle.description: X: replaces the X Article (title, headings); {} makes it an ordinary X post again.

xQuotePostId.description: X — the post this one QUOTES; an empty string removes the quote. Named apart from the Threads `quotePostId` on this same schedule.

yourBrand.description: TIKTOK — the own-brand disclosure; false turns it off.
